records.text: Pioneer Group still hasn't created a project a week in, flagging for outreach

records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ines,

A quick nudge: Wrenfield works best once your team's actual tasks are in it. If you've been meaning to set that up, today's as good a day as any.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Pioneer Group!
records.body:
Hi Ines,

Thanks for signing up for Wrenfield. Two things that help teams get going: create a project, and invite at least one teammate from Account Settings -> Members.

Happy to answer anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: No customer reply to either outreach ([email:6549d9e1], [email:872f55ff]), zero tickets, and after 6 days no project, no invite, no milestone. Fully silent accounts rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days, though Pro status implies some intent.

draft.subject: Getting Pioneer Group's first project set up
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

You're a week into Wrenfield and I want to make sure the start is easy rather than one more thing on your list. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so one real project is usually the fastest way to see whether Wrenfield fits how Pioneer Group works. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm glad to walk through that first project with you and answer anything as we go.

Best,
Chidi
